english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that gives off a lot of light or a place that is well lit.
Use this for a room or place that is cheerful because it is bright and pleasant.

examples.english: This room is really bright, so we don't need to turn on the lights.
examples.traditional: 呢間房真係光猛，唔使開燈。
